title: TypeFlow
description: Minimalist, ad-free typing speed test with timed, word and code modes, live WPM and accuracy, switchable themes and synthesized key sounds.

title: DevResume.Studio
description: Developer resume builder with a visual form, Markdown and JSON editing, a live A4 or Letter preview, an ATS audit score, presets, autosave and print-to-PDF export.

title: Nightplay Arcade
description: A library of small browser games for short breaks, with no installs and no accounts. Four games so far: a canvas-rendered Snake and three typing games, with keyboard-first navigation and best-score tracking.
